## What's Changed
* 0.2.1: null inputs never become indicator values; Polars 2 support by @Yvictor in https://github.com/Yvictor/polars_ta_extension/pull/43
* ci: publish a release when its notes land on master by @Yvictor in https://github.com/Yvictor/polars_ta_extension/pull/44

## Install

```sh
pip install -U polars-talib==0.2.1
uv add polars-talib==0.2.1
```

## Notes
* **Null inputs no longer become indicator values (fixes #42).** A Polars null is a missing observation. After the first usable row, every output row that can depend on a null input is now null: to the end of the partition for recursive indicators (RSI, EMA, MACD, ATR, OBV, SMA, most candlestick patterns), and for the lookback window for window-bounded ones (MAX/MIN, WILLR, AROON, ROC, math operators). Under `.over("symbol")` a null only affects its own symbol. Previously TA-Lib 0.8.1 could turn a null into plausible values, for example RSI returning 0.0 for every row after a gap.
* **Behavior change:** rows that depend on a null input are now null instead of NaN or a finite value. NaN and ±inf are ordinary float values and still reach TA-Lib unchanged; use `fill_nan(None)` when they mean "missing". See the [upgrade guide](https://github.com/Yvictor/polars_ta_extension/blob/0.2.1/docs/upgrade-0.2.0.md#missing-inputs) for restarting after gaps or skipping market-closed rows.
* **Polars 2 support (fixes #41).** The dependency is now `polars>=1.20,<3`; CI tests Polars 1.20, 1.44 and 2.0.
* No measurable slowdown for data without nulls: across all 201 indicators 0.2.1 runs at 1.01x of 0.2.0.
* Published PyPI wheels for macOS x86_64, macOS arm64, Linux x86_64 (glibc and musl), Linux aarch64 (glibc and musl), Windows x64 and Windows ARM64, plus the sdist.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Yvictor/polars_ta_extension/compare/0.2.0...0.2.1
